notes: Page read independently from the whole image once for layout and each supplied half once, then 17 enhanced crops of still-open loci. No other page, reader file, OCR, recognition, external source, compilation or installation was used.
Whole-image size is 1678 by 2360 pixels. Half a covers y=0–1260; half b covers y=1100–2360. All finding boxes use original whole coordinates.
There is no H_drawings supplement in the packet, and S.json is the empty array; therefore no S decisions are outstanding.

Content: involutions and their change under translation, odd/even corollary and a slanted cyclic-group note; then the internal heading Parenthèse and a pullback-of-sets discussion with group and kernel remarks. No date or manuscript page number is visible. The lower-left 11 is archive foliation in an unnamed hand and is only a TeX comment.
No explicit authorial question mark or doubt phrase is visible. Mon is transcribed as written, without expanding it; possible expansions appear only in the abbreviation notes.
The written first bijectif) has no separately visible opening parenthesis. It is retained unmatched. The opening sentence has a colon after équivaut; the unusual wording is not repaired.
C doubts are mapped in textual order C01–C21, with no nested unsure calls on this page. Eight are resolved and thirteen retained. Newly added doubts have empty doubt_action fields.

The two top traces and far-right paired points are reproduced as uncertain detached marks, without declaring them punctuation or assigning a mathematical function. Their surface-versus-writing status remains open.

H’s page marker and declared macro equivalents are not counted as collation errors. Emph versus uline, struck versus deleted, and uncertainty syntax alone are ignored; actual missing state, ink, underlining or geometry is reported.

checks.statement: Conjugation chain under the inversion relation
checks.reasoning: Conditionally assuming sigma g sigma^{-1}=g^{-1}, sigma g^{-1} sigma^{-1}=g, hence g sigma g^{-1}=g^2 sigma=sigma g^{-2}.
checks.outcome: The displayed identity is algebraically consistent under that stated condition; the check did not choose any glyph.

checks.statement: Odd/even fibre count for the cyclic parameter
checks.reasoning: For a cyclic group of order n, the square map has kernel size gcd(2,n). It is bijective when n is odd and has nonempty fibres of size 2 when n is even; when n=2m, the kernel is {1,u^m}.
checks.outcome: This is consistent with the written odd corollary, even NB and marginal note, including empty fibres. No word was selected by this calculation.

checks.statement: Kernel and surjectivity statements for the displayed pullback
checks.reasoning: In P={(x,y):p(x)=q(y)}, projection to F has kernel {(x,1):p(x)=1}, and projection to E has kernel {(1,y):q(y)=1}. If p is onto, an x exists for each q(y); if p is bijective that x is unique.
checks.outcome: The written kernel pairings and transfer of surjectivity/bijectivity hold under the stated group/map hypotheses; the headless shafts and unmatched parenthesis are nevertheless retained.
